g.text: Pair 80 · same segments at each depth
Pair 100 · same segments at each depth
Each red/blue pair integrates exactly the same horizontal intervals. No missing interval is filled or counted as zero.
Available segments change with depth. No nonempty set of segments is supported by BOTH methods at every depth from 1.13 to 10 mm.
Gray strip: approximately 12 masked pixels. Units assume DX in metres/pixel and DT in seconds; local surface uses the existing inferred offset.
